T1_same_dimensional_acceptance.statement: A 5D closed engine identity can map/read into a 5D closed engine profile; dimension reduction is not required.

T2_lower_dimensional_seed.statement: 5D->dD projection may be many-to-one while the resulting shadow acts as a seed into a constrained higher-dimensional lift fiber.

T3_identity_under_transform.statement: Identity is preserved under any declared admissible geometric transformation that preserves History-decorated recursive tower equivalence.

T4_engine_vector_relation.statement: Propagation vector/readout is induced by current dimensional engagement of the engine identity rather than attached as an independent primitive.

T5_profile_contract_branch.statement: Generic profile contract reduces to closed recursive profile plus admissible transformation class; profile-specific extra invariants are optional refinements.
